The most common and robust greedy strategy for bin packing is First Fit Decreasing (FFD). This strategy involves placing the largest items (highest score students) first, which typically leads to a more compact packing.

def ffd_packing(scores, K):
    # Sort scores in decreasing order
    sorted_scores = sorted(scores, reverse=True)
    
    # Initialize K groups, tracking remaining capacity
    group_capacities = [1.0] * K
    
    print(f"--- Starting FFD with K={K} ---")
    
    for i, score in enumerate(sorted_scores):
        placed = False
        # Try to fit into the first available group
        for j in range(K):
            if group_capacities[j] >= score:
                group_capacities[j] -= score
                print(f"Student score {score:.2f} placed in Group {j+1}. Remaining capacity: {group_capacities[j]:.2f}")
                placed = True
                break
        
        if not placed:
            print(f"\nFAILURE: Cannot place score {score:.2f} into any of the {K} groups.")
            return False
            
    print("\n--- Packing Successful ---")
    return True
